a.text: Where... am I...?
Pain, rip, shatter.
Every bit of suffering is piled upon my body, every person killed silently is myself.
No, I must...
But, why can I not summon the strength?
Someone seems to be urgently calling my name...
'Amiya!'
'You promised me—'
*Incoherent voices*
Is that the Doctor? I can't tell.
I want to reply. I try opening my mouth, just to tell the Doctor I'm fine.
The pain starts to fade away as the chaotic scene finally becomes clear.
I search for what strength remains in my body.
'I see cities, devastated.'
'I see Originium, blanketing the land.'
'I see you—'
The fuzzy echoes get further away as I open my eyes.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: This is... a battlefield.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: My battlefield, the battlefield of the 'King of Sarkaz'.

a.text: An army lies dormant behind me, silently raising their banners up high, soaked through with blood, pain and suffering...
...of ours... of our enemies.

steps.name: Nachzehrer King
steps.text: We will take this last city. Their resistance has reached an end.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You are... the king of the Nachzehrer Court.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: What's your name?

steps.name: Nachzehrer King
steps.text: I have no name. I am merely your loyal subject, 'King of Sarkaz'.

steps.name: Nachzehrer King
steps.text: This is your fate. You will bring us salvation.

steps.name: Nachzehrer King
steps.text: All that we fervently wish for, all that we have finally achieved... salvation.

a.text: I nod slightly.
A droning cry fills the air, declaring a new chapter of destruction. The earth beneath my feet, it squirms, it curls, all because of me.
This is the grace the 'Lord of Fiends' has bequeathed the lands.
The formation begins advancing.

steps.name: Nachzehrer King
steps.text: Your will is our will.

steps.name: Nachzehrer King
steps.text: You have answered the prophecy, and thus it will yield its rewards.

steps.name: Nachzehrer King
steps.text: Please leave it to us. This battle will not drag much longer.

a.text: Prophecy?
Prophecy.
I once heard that...

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You look exhausted these days.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Amiya, you can't go on like this. You need to rest.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Theresa?

a.text: Is that it? I'm... exhausted?
We fought a difficult battle at the Defense Forces' control tower, with Dr. Kal'tsit taking a serious injury.
Norport Borough has been locked down, all its residents left for dead.
We are at the tender mercies of Victoria's Catastrophes... But our military is yet to give up.
Within the Sargonian City of Gold, the Zhayedan millennium-old roars nailed shut in their coffins.
Zwillingstürme's spires rotted and crumbling, not a tune ever to ring out again.
The eternal holy city of Laterano, its pure white cathedral dyed in black, their ancient betrayal paid in full.
Even under the tides... The arrogant Ægir bow their heads to me. For those still try to uphold their dignity, I claim them one by one.
In all of these, one solitary figure remains constant.
Is all of this my doing?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Is all of this... my doing?

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: These are all things you need to do, Amiya.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: You have come to the origin of it all.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: This is also our fated end.

a.text: I feel something flowing out the edge of my eyes.
Theresa raises a gentle hand and wipes my tears away.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: Don't be like this, Amiya.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: 'King of Sarkaz'. I personally placed this crown upon your head, and brought to you this pain... and glory.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: We will face it together.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: This is... the will of the myriad souls. We cannot deny it.

steps.name: Theresa
steps.text: The more you reject it, the more you suffer. The more you resist it, the weaker you are.

a.text: Theresa's face begins to blur.
All of them are telling me this, all at once.
Across millennia, all the Sarkaz within the myriad souls, they are all telling me this.
There is no rebuke, no terror.
They just... truly wish for me to be at peace once more.

steps.name: Theresa?
steps.text: We have seen so much defiance of fate. Prophecies manifest early before those who defy it, and it is clear as day where they will ultimately fall.

steps.name: Theresa?
steps.text: We are grateful for those pointless challenges. Through their struggles they weave an ode to heroes, yet the heroes themselves are destined to perish.

steps.name: Theresa?
steps.text: The more you reject it, the more you suffer.

steps.name: Theresa?
steps.text: Because you understand. All choices, all struggles, all fatigue, the sorrow you swallow, they bear no meaning. Rejecting it only embitters the gentle hand of fate.

steps.name: Theresa?
steps.text: The more you resist it, the weaker you are.

steps.name: Theresa?
steps.text: Because you realize. All fights, all resistance, the blood we spill, our haggard words, they have no destination. Resistance only fills your destined home with thorns.

steps.name: Theresa?
steps.text: Why bother... why bother.

steps.name: Theresa?
steps.text: We only wish for you to rest.

steps.name: Theresa?
steps.text: Close your eyes, Amiya.

a.text: Close your eyes.
Millions of kin bow down before my rusted throne. They will bear Kazdel here.
The King spurs them, the King drives them, the King enslaves them.
This is your mission. This is my mission.
This is my... predestined fate.
'A good ending, is never earned.'
'This is fate. I tasted, too much.'
'I fought fate, so many years... in the end, I could not win.'
'But you... maybe you're...'
'Will you... admit it?'
'You're afraid, little King.'
'You know, my ending. You believe, all the prophecies, will be realized.'
'You will be, the origin of ruin. You will be, the harbinger of disaster.'
'You decide, you accept.'
'...Really?'
I—
Without exception, Amiya.
Even he, Buldrokkas'tee, succumbed to fate.
Are you stronger than him? Braver than him? Do you think those soft shoulders of yours can bear the weight of the frost and blades he's borne?
At the end of your journey, you will regret, you will suffer for your sin. Your sin of not being able to accept who you are!
Look at your hands, child. Look at your hands.
I glance down, feeling at my hands. I try curling my hands into fists.
Is this my will?
On the vast battlefield, I stand alone.
Innumerable corpses.
The Black Crown hovers above her head.

steps.name: Amiya?
steps.text: 'I see you, black crown on your head, melting millions of lives, into nothing but memories.'

steps.name: Amiya?
steps.text: 'I see the, King of Sarkaz, enslaving all peoples, everywhere.'

steps.name: Amiya?
steps.text: You will regret.

steps.name: Amiya?
steps.text: You will fall in regret, just like me.

steps.name: Amiya?
steps.text: The final destination... is still here.

steps.name: Amiya?
steps.text: When death approaches, you will realize, that all prophecies, are inevitable.

steps.name: Amiya?
steps.text: I... am the most horrific disaster to afflict our world.

a.text: I am the most horrific disaster to afflict our world.
I step forward, towards Amiya, towards myself.
Towards fate itself.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Then...

a.text: Black Arts weave into a sword, stabbing the Amiya in front of me.
Stabbing myself through the chest.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Then, I will kill you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even if, you are me, you are the 'Lord of Fiends'.

steps.name: Amiya?
steps.text: I once... made the same choice as you.

steps.name: Amiya?
steps.text: I thought that I was strong enough, powerful enough to unbind myself from fate's shackles.

steps.name: Amiya?
steps.text: You can't do it.

steps.name: Amiya?
steps.text: Amiya... you can't do it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Really.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Maybe.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You may have tried once, you may have faced all sorts of bitterness and still fallen into the same abyss in the end.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But I haven't.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I have not walked on your so-called 'fated path'.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I will challenge you.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I will challenge you, in my, the King of Sarkaz's name, 'Amiya'.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If the end of it all was set in stone long ago by those prophecies you espouse, if the meaning of our lives are just to prove your inevitable conclusion...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Then why do we live?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Why do we exist?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The Patriot's lifelong struggle, Dr. Kal'tsit's assiduous choices, Dr. {@nickname} holding my hand and affirming our path—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: All this just to become a footnote in fate's manuscript?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I refuse to accept it.

steps.name: Theresa?
steps.text: Amiya, this will only beget pain.

steps.name: Theresa?
steps.text: It will be, an endless torture.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Myriad souls of Kazdel, I ask you. Did Theresa break out of her own fate?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Even Theresis, did he face you head on?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Theresa... She handed over this crown to me, for this.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She didn't believe in the predestined tragic future that you paint.

steps.name: Sarkaz Myriad Souls?
steps.text: So she is suffering now... Listening to our voices with nary a rest!

steps.name: Sarkaz Myriad Souls?
steps.text: If only to relieve her burden, 'King of Sarkaz', you must—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Theresa doesn't need any rescue.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The 'King of Sarkaz' will no longer be a symbol of conquest and revenge.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Maybe... that's why I must be the one.

steps.name: Sarkaz Myriad Souls?
steps.text: How arrogant, how conceited—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, it is only because I have worn this black crown, that I brandish my sword at you.

steps.name: Sarkaz Myriad Souls?
steps.text: You cannot escape fate's choice. The further you run from it, the faster it will come—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I won't run.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'll wait here for it. 'Fate'.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: When your plans have dissipated, when your taunts fall short.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'll show you all—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: We... The peoples of this great land, can choose an ending for ourselves.

a.text: I find the strength in my body.
They call this power the King of Sarkaz.
But I know, it was never about the King. This power was never meant for conquest, for subjugation.
Its true objective is—
'Survival'.
The battlefield abruptly shatters.
I hear a distant sigh.
It carries no anger, no fear, no sorrow.
Just a sigh.
Was this a reply from the myriad souls, or... just myself sleep-talking as I awake from a nightmare?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Mm—
Amiya, you're awake!

a.text: A familiar voice beckons. I feel those lingering emotions dissipate.

steps.text: Do you feel alright? Any pain?
You got hit by Confessarius witchcraft. Did you have a nightmare?

a.text: The Doctor's voice always calms me down.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm fine now.

a.text: I lift my hand, the black Arts sparking out as usual.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...The 'King of Sarkaz'.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, this power is not a curse. It's not forbidden witchcraft that brings disaster.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Theresa passed it to me, so that... we can use it to find our own path.
I trust you.

a.text: The Doctor holds my hands tightly.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: You're up, Amiya.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I'm sorry.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's fine... Logos.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Whether or not I was caught by Confessarius witchcraft, I would have had to face this... self-reflection eventually.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: In my dream, those voices proclaimed the prophecy again.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Prophecy?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Yes... The prophecy The Patriot spoke of before he died.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: No matter what voices they were, it's all a trick of the Confessarii.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Don't worry about it.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Was that a method of Confessarius torture, or are the myriad souls still deeply connected to my heart?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Or maybe I... still hold on to that scary prophecy deep down inside.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: It's not important, though. I already rejected their offer.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Again.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: ...Good.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: I still want you to get a full checkup from Dr. Kal'tsit, though. Your rings...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I do.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Um, Logos, where are we though...?

a.text: The sound of footsteps approaches, it's... some Sarkaz mercenaries? They're moving a crystal shard the color of blood onto a truck not far away.
I recognize the girl leading them, Paprika. The Doctor said she freed the workers in Highbury.

steps.text: Logos requisitioned the use of this Sarkaz transport squad's vehicle. In the name of the Lord of the Banshees.
We need to escape the Confessarii pursuit.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Yesterday, Closure's drones found us. W's safehouse that they were staying at were also attacked by the Confessarii, and Nightingale was captured.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...The Confessarii.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: We let our guard down against this Sarkaz squad named after the Confessarii. Theresis's plan also allowed them freedom of movement.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: However, they've finally left the shadows they've been hiding in.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Doctor, Paprika and the others are loading the Originium samples you need on board. But they're still wary of us.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Right now, they're only listening to me because they fear me. I might have to resort to threatening them with real curses soon.
Five batches of crystals should be enough. Amiya's recovered as well.

steps.name: Logos
steps.text: Then, we will head to Brentwood next and meet up with Dr. Kal'tsit.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor, you look uneasy... What's worrying you?
I fear that Theresis isn't looking for any sort of Vampire witchcraft device.
What he wants is... an even more unsettling power.
